entities.summary: Mojave Jackson King is a New Zealand-American professional basketball player for Mykonos of the Greek Basketball League (GBL). He began his career in the Australian NBL in 2020, playing his first season for the Cairns Taipans. After a season with the Adelaide 36ers, he joined the NBA G League Ignite in 2022. He was selected by the Los Angeles Lakers with the 47th overall pick in the 2023 NBA draft.
